newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BRUSSELS BOURSE SAYS JULY WAS RECORD MONTH.
newsitem.headline: BRUSSELS BOURSE SAYS JULY WAS RECORD MONTH.

text.p: The Brussels Stock Exchange said on Thursday that July was a record month in volume terms and almost equalled the previous record for a rise in the Bel-20 index.
Total bourse volume was 128.9 billion Belgian francs, up 5.1 percent on June, the previous record month. Average daily volume was 5.8 billion francs compared with 2.7 billion a year ago.
In the month, the Bel-20 rose by 8.34 percent compared with the record rise of 8.37 percent recorded in January 1996, the bourse said in a statement.
